_meta.description: Genealogy of the named characters appearing in the cut Greek story records (data/raw/batch-29-greek-stories.json and batch-30-hesiod-more-stories.json). position = role or office. parents and consorts are references to other person ids. children are derivable from the parents lists. stories list the corpus story ids a figure features in.

originClasses.primordial: Present at or before the cosmos (Chaos, Gaia, Ouranos, Tartarus, Nyx...)
originClasses.god: Full immortal deity of the Olympian or pre-Olympian order
originClasses.daimon: Personified abstraction or lesser divine spirit (Fates, Furies, Dreams, Fear...)
originClasses.nymph: Immortal nature spirit of sea, river or tree (Nereids, Oceanids, Calypso...)
originClasses.demigod: One divine parent beside a mortal parent (Achilles, Heracles, Helen, Aeneas...)
originClasses.monster: Monstrous being, often with divine parents (Polyphemus, Scylla, Typhon, Pegasus...) — Polyphemus/Scylla/Cerberus have god parents but monstrous nature
originClasses.mortal: Human being, however royal or heroised; Pandora is divinely moulded but mortal

_meta.note: Some catalog figures (e.g. the ~400 named in Hesiod's full Theogony) appear in the background genealogy lists but not in the cut story narratives; only persons named or acting in the cut stories are recorded here.
